q: Parabolic implosion (Douady–Lavaurs) occurs when a quadratic polynomial fc approaches a parabolic parameter c₀. The Hausdorff limit of J(fc) as c→c₀:
opts: Is strictly larger than J(fc₀) — the Julia set 'implodes' as petals collapse
exp: Parabolic implosion: as c→c₀ (parabolic), the Fatou petals collapse and the Julia set grows discontinuously in Hausdorff metric. Hausdorff-lim J(fc) ⊋ J(fc₀). This is a fundamental discontinuity in the family of Julia sets, studied via Lavaurs maps.
